facts.value: Implements Kirby's copied-Popo neutral-special entry and motion callback family, command-driven construction/tracking/release/removal of a Kirby IceClimberIce item, and accessory setup. Also defines ftKb_SpecialNYs_80109238, a fixed TransN2 bone-index lookup consumed by copied-Yoshi item attachment and teardown positioning. The TU is not exclusively a copied-Popo module.
facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported tongue/Egg Lay and visual-resource assertions with canonical bodies and actual table/caller evidence.

facts.value: A null xC0 causes no removal. Otherwise the function passes xC0 to it_802C17DC, reacquires Fighter user data, compares fp->u.kb.xC0 with fp2->u.kb.xC0, and stores NULL on equality. Neither operand preserves the pre-call item pointer. With unchanged Fighter user data both operands refer to the same current field, so this comparison does not generally protect a replacement item installed during the call. The adjacent explicit-item notification helper separately clears only when its candidate equals the stored item.

evidence.why: Shows explicit candidate equality versus two post-call current-field reads.

facts.value: Calls ft_80082708(gobj). Only on a false result, optionally passes non-null xC0 to it_802C17DC, reacquires Fighter user data, compares two post-call xC0 field reads and conditionally stores NULL. No old item pointer is saved for comparison. Every false-query path then calls ftCo_Fall_Enter with the original gobj, whether or not an item was tracked.
facts.rationale: Preserves exact nesting without inferring the query's complete contact meaning or replacement-safe ownership.

evidence.why: Complete query, optional removal, field reads, and Fall forwarding.

facts.value: Resolves Fighter and ftKb_DatAttrs, then calls ft_80081D0C. A result unequal to GA_Ground triggers optional non-null xC0 removal through it_802C17DC and conditional clearing using two post-call current-field reads, not a saved old item pointer. The comma expression yields its second operand. The branch then resets xC4 to zero and xC8 to 0.0F and forwards gobj, false, and specialn_pp_landing_lag to ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter.
facts.rationale: Repairs unchanged-reference language and preserves the canonical predicate and arguments.

evidence.why: Complete data flow and post-call comparison.

facts.value: Provides collision-phase cleanup and landing-helper dispatch for the copied-Popo aerial motion: on ft_80081D0C(gobj) != GA_Ground, requests removal of any tracked ice item, performs current-field reference clearing, resets xC4/xC8, and calls the common special-landing entry with false and the configured lag argument.
facts.rationale: Uses active table membership and exact local behavior rather than inferred enum meaning, visual attachment, or saved-item protection.

facts.value: A GA_Ground query result causes no move-specific cleanup/reset. Any other result performs optional tracked-item removal, resets xC4/xC8, and invokes ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter with false and the lag attribute. The consumer may route to HammerLanding; otherwise it forwards LandingFallSpecial with playback rate (0.1F + fp->x2EC) / landing_lag. Neither caller nor this entry checks that lag is positive and finite; zero, negative, NaN, and infinite values are not sanitized into a guaranteed valid duration.
facts.rationale: Adds the verified optional consumer branch and exceptional-input boundary instead of promising unconditional special recovery.

evidence.why: Hammer alternative and unchecked lag division.

facts.value: Clears throw_flags, cmd_vars[0], and xC0. If (s32)xC4 == 0, assigns specialn_pp_air_vertical_momentum to self_vel.y, sets xC4 true, and writes 0.0F to xC8; otherwise leaves self_vel.y directly unchanged and writes -10.0F to xC8. Both branches enter ftKb_MS_PpSpecialAirN with arguments 0, 0.0F, 1.0F, 0.0F, NULL, call ftAnim_8006EBA4, install fn_801090D4, and select the PEACH-indexed accessory resource with the LThumbNb joint. The momentum attribute is unchecked and not proved positive. The paired aerial collision callback clears xC4/xC8 only on its non-GA_Ground result branch.
facts.rationale: Replaces guaranteed upward motion and complete per-airtime claims with literal assignments and reset conditions.

evidence.why: Exact guard, values, calls, and resource index.
